sections.title: Who operates BeyBridge
sections.body: BeyBridge is operated by {{operator}}. For privacy questions or requests, contact {{email}}.

sections.title: Account and service information
sections.body: We process your account email or phone number, authentication information, name, profile preferences, favorites, reviews, service listings, and service requests to operate the marketplace. Requests can include your phone number, service address, coordinates, schedule, budget, and messages. The provider receiving your request can see its details. Public listings and reviews are visible to other users.

sections.title: Location and documents
sections.body: Location access is optional and requested when you use nearby services or choose a service location. You can decline permission and search manually. BeyBridge does not request background location. Map and tile providers receive network requests for the areas you view. Coordinates you explicitly save in listings or requests are stored with that content. Verification documents are stored privately and made available to authorized administrators for review.

sections.title: Notifications and diagnostics
sections.body: If you enable notifications, we store a device push token, device name, platform, and app version to deliver account updates through Expo and platform notification services. You can turn notifications off in device settings or the app. When crash reporting is configured, Sentry receives diagnostic events, app/device information, and an account identifier; default personal-information collection is disabled. Network service providers may process connection information such as IP addresses.

sections.title: Sharing and security
sections.body: BeyBridge uses Supabase for authentication, database records, and private file storage. Configured email services send account and administrative messages. Service providers receive the information you submit to them. Calling, opening WhatsApp, directions, or social sign-in takes you to another service governed by its own policies. Data is transmitted using encrypted connections, and access to private records is restricted. Do not include unnecessary sensitive information in public content or requests.

sections.title: Deletion and your choices
sections.body: You can edit your profile and delete reviews or listings where available. To delete your account, open Account → Delete account, sign in if necessary, and confirm the deletion. You can also request deletion without installing the app by contacting {{email}} from your account email, or identifying your account phone number. We verify ownership before fulfilling an email request; never send your password or verification codes. Deletion removes your authentication account and associated active database records, listings, reviews, service requests, notifications, and verification files. Copies already received by other people or external services are governed by their policies. Contact {{email}} about requests concerning other records.

sections.title: Retention and policy updates
sections.body: Account data is kept while your account exists to provide the service, unless you delete it sooner. Backup retention: {{backups}}. Operational log retention: {{logs}}. Material changes will be reflected in this policy and its update date.

sections.title: Using BeyBridge
sections.body: BeyBridge connects customers with independent local service providers. Providers are responsible for their services, availability, qualifications, quotes, and fulfillment. Confirm scope, safety, and payment arrangements directly with your provider. A verification badge does not guarantee service quality or eliminate risk. For emergencies, contact the appropriate local emergency service.

sections.title: Content you submit
sections.body: Only submit content you have the right to share. Listings must describe real services accurately, and reviews must reflect your experience. Do not submit harassment, threats, hate speech, sexual exploitation, illegal content, scams, impersonation, spam, fabricated reviews, or someone else's private information. Do not offer prohibited or unsafe services. You are responsible for the information you publish.

sections.title: Reporting and moderation
sections.body: Use Report on a service listing or review to report inappropriate content. Use Block on a listing or review to hide that user's listings and reviews and prevent new in-app service requests between you. Manage blocks from Account → Blocked users. Existing requests stay accessible; blocking does not affect external calls or chats. Reports are reviewed by administrators, who can suspend listings and take appropriate action. Reporting is private; it does not automatically remove content. Contact {{email}} for safety concerns or appeals. Abuse of reporting or repeated violations can result in restrictions or account removal.

sections.title: Your account and deletion
sections.body: Keep your account secure and contact {{email}} if you suspect misuse. You may delete your account from the Account screen or request deletion by email. Deletion is permanent and can remove shared service-request history. Do not rely on the app as your only record of important service arrangements.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: These terms are provided by {{operator}}. Questions or complaints can be sent to {{email}}.

sections.title: Delete in the app or on the web
sections.body: Open BeyBridge → Account → Delete account. Sign in to the account you want to delete, review what will be removed, type DELETE, and confirm. Deletion is permanent; it is not temporary deactivation. You can also use the signed-in account deletion page on this website.

sections.title: Request deletion without the app
sections.body: Email {{email}} with the subject BeyBridge account deletion, preferably from the email associated with your account. If you registered by phone, identify that number. We verify account ownership before deleting data. Do not send passwords, verification codes, or identity documents by email. No app installation is required to make this request.

sections.title: What is deleted
sections.body: Deletion removes your authentication account, profile, favorites, reviews, service listings, associated service requests and their history, notifications and push registrations, verification submissions and uploaded files, and related reports or moderation records. Shared requests associated with your account or listings also disappear from the other participant's app. Deletion cannot recall information already received by other people, such as an email, phone call, or external chat.

sections.title: Other copies and questions
sections.body: Backup retention: {{backups}}. Operational log retention: {{logs}}. Contact {{email}} for questions or other data-deletion requests.
